data.description: When a hive creature dies, it exudes a pool of its corrosive blood in the space it occupies. This pool deals %1d6 points of acid damage for 3 rounds to objects and creatures in those squares (Reflex DC %2 half). This acid damages whatever surface it is on, and if it deals enough damage to destroy the surface, the acid falls down to any subsequent floor below and continues to deal damage.
data.name: Death Throes
